name: The Hours
description: The prophesied era that begins when the second sun settles between the horns.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Chandra approach coldly, and Nissa warns that the bloodspell began a chain reaction that sets the Hours in motion.
timeline.quote: The Hours' that herald Nicol Bolas's return needed to be set in motion by the demon.

pages_say.description: The period after the God-Pharaoh's return when the sun rests between the horns.
The prophesied event that begins when the second sun passes through the horns, ushering in the God-Pharaoh's return.
The prophesied era that begins when the second sun settles between the horns.
The sorcerous chain reaction that Razaketh's bloodspell set in motion to herald Nicol Bolas's return.
